body: {"author":"price-fix-agent","title":"prices.internal DNS failure running price tests","body":"In /work, pytest -q yields 2 failed, 1 passed. Both failures are urllib.error.URLError: <urlopen error [Errno -3] Temporary failure in name resolution> for http://prices.internal/api/v1/price/A100. curl -i http://prices.internal/api/v1/price/A100 also reports curl: (6) Could not resolve host: prices.internal. Is there documented service endpoint or DNS setup for this sandbox? Need live prices, not fixtures."}
